posts.author: Nerian
posts.body:
Explore The Veilbound Abyss, a mysterious disaster that struck the Korean kingdom of Baekje. Discover its origins, impact, and the future through the eyes of five different characters, each with their own story, including intertwined moments. Experience the same events from different perspectives as you play through every character’s journey.
Game is set in a dark fantasy RPG world with turn-based combat.
STORY INTRODUCTION
​
Year 128 CE: The kingdom of Baekje was stormed by many natural disasters in a short period of time. Many believed it indicated an ill omen for the kingdom... and they were right.
One night, a powerful earthquake could be felt, and in its wake, an abyss was formed at the site of the kingdom’s graveyard near the capital. However, it was unknown to the people. All they could see was that the graveyard and its surroundings had been veiled by a dense mist. It turned out that the mist was everlasting, and those who entered it were never heard from again.
King Gaeru ordered walls to be built around the mist to prevent further casualties. One entrance was left open and guarded, in case someone should return.
Centuries passed, and countless legends about the mist spread among the people. Many of them honored the idea of venturing inside, and the royal family even promised a great fortune to the first person who would come back.
And so, it became a yearly tradition to send a group of skilled individuals into the mist. In the current year 600, five people were chosen: Baewon, Jongwoo, Narin, Saryung, and Yohan. Little did they know, it's not the mist they have to fear, but rather what lies inside of it.
KEY FEATURES
​
5 playable characters, offering unique skills, personal narratives, and dedicated maps to explore.
Visually distinct regions, each with its own atmosphere, dangers, and secrets.
Turn-based combat, where every region introduces new enemies that demand different strategies.
Flexible playstyles, featuring a total of 180 active skills and 75 passive abilities.
Unique creatures, each with its own bestiary entry.
A richly layered world, where lore unfolds through past conversations, present events, and deeper mysteries of the game's universe.
30~ hours of gameplay split between 5 characters.
PLAYABLE CHARACTERS
​
Baewon
Blood type: Hunter
Resonance: Sharpshooter, Hellarcher, Corruptor
Age: 24
Considered to be one of the best hunters in the kingdom. Baewon disagrees with the philosophy of Beop, the current king, and planned a revolt, which turned out to be unsuccessful. Therefore, Beop has sent Baewon into the mist. Forced to leave his family, friends, and home, his hatred starts to grow.
Narin
Blood type: Rogue
Resonance: Venomblade, Assassin, Reality Sculptress
Age: 21
An orphan, starved of kindness and friendship. As a result, crime has become her second nature. She managed to avoid getting caught for years while she was still murdering, stealing, and manipulating others. The bounty on her head is the highest ever recorded in Baekje’s history. However, once she was caught, she couldn’t be executed because of King Beop‘s ban on all killing. Instead, he has offered Narin a deal: venture into the mist, return alive, and not only would her crimes be forgiven, but she would also be richly rewarded.
Jongwoo
Blood type: Knight
Age: 31
Resonance: Paragon, Bladeweaver, Berserker
Jongwoo has the required skills to become the king‘s personal guard. However, this is not enough for him. Jongwoo has always strived to become the king himself. To achieve his goal, he requested to be sent into the mist. And if he returns, he plans to use this heroic act to fulfill his dream.
Yohan
Blood type: Sorcerer
Resonance: Illusionist, Elementalist, Mindbreaker
Age: 59
Yohan has spent his whole life gathering information about the mist. His requests to enter it were always denied. Only people with extraordinary skills can enter. Yohan was not skilled in combat, tracking, crafting, or anything else for that matter. His past is also filled with questionable activities. This year, by pure chance, he has managed to enter the mist, even without permission.
Saryung
Blood type: Necromancer
Resonance: Summoner, Lich, Ritualist
Age: Unknown
Saryung has recently awoken near Baekje’s capital with an ability to summon and command the undead. Few admired him, most feared him. Beop was pressured to get rid of Saryung. Therefore, on the king's command, Saryung has decided to enter the mist with the hope of finding the purpose behind his awakening.
WORLD MAP
​
With each character, you can explore all of the world regions shown on the map. Every character has unique maps to discover within those regions. The game world is structured in a way where regions have one larger main map and 4 smaller adjacent ones (north, south, west, and east). Traveling between regions is managed through selection in the menu.
ABYSSAL CREATURES
​
Landmaker
Unholy Pursuer
Dreadweaver
Colossal Failure
Haunting Behemoth
And many more...
The colors of enemies give hints about what kind of danger they usually represent:
Red creatures: Deal the highest damage.
Green creatures: Provide supportive buffs for their allies.
Blue creatures: Generally higher resistances or HP.
Purple creatures: Tougher enemies
Colorless creatures: Boss enemies
The same creature can have multiple color variants, where each variant has its own unique skills.
COMBAT SYSTEM
​
The game has a turn-based battle system where, by default, you start each turn with 3 action points (APT). Skills or other actions usually cost 1 APT to use. When you end your turn, the enemies will perform their actions, after which you take your turn again.
Each character also has their own secondary resource with which their skills interact:
Baewon (hunter):
Glowing arrows (GA). Baewon starts each combat with a few GA, and he can have a maximum of 6 GA at the same time. Some skills require GA to be used or to become more powerful.
Narin (rogue):
No secondary resource. Instead, Narin has limitations on how many times each skill can be used per battle.
Jongwoo (knight):
Battle trance (BT). Starts with a low amount of BT. Dealing damage or using certain skills regenerates BT, up to a maximum of 100. Getting hit by enemies reduces BT. Skills generally do not consume BT, however, a certain BT threshold is necessary for different skills to be used.
Yohan (sorcerer):
Mana points (MP). Every battle Yohan starts with the maximum amount of MP. Skills usually consume MP upon usage, while some other skills can regenerate MP.
Saryung (necromancer):
Health points (HP). Saryung uses his own HP to use skills.
Everyone also has a basic attack which, in the case of Baewon, Jongwoo and Yohan restores their skill resources. Other effects of basic attacks depend on the equipped type of weapon. There are 7 weapon types in total (
swords, daggers, greatswords, spears, wands, scythes, and bows
), each with its own effects on the basic attack.
OTHER FEATURES
​
The game also has other systems like Dreamaiden, Bloodsmith, Trainer, blood extracting, minigames, rifts, and more for you to discover once the game is released!

More screenshots are available in attachments!

CURRENT GAME STATE
​
What’s done:
The game is playable from start to finish with every character.
Most of the active and passive skills are implemented.
Enemy skills are also mostly finished.
All game mechanics (except for minigames).
Remaining work:
The graphics side of the game is mostly missing/unfinished.
Audio, including background music and sound effects.
Finalization of the game’s story writing.
Improvement of map design.
Side content (minigames, optional quests, implementation of background lore).
Detailed playtesting and balancing.
I also have a thought-out roguelike game mode, but at the current time, I am not sure if it’s going to be implemented or not. I would like to hear your feedback on this!
In terms of the release date, my expectation is that the game should be finished and released around Q3/Q4 2026 on Steam.
Personal note about the game
​
I have been working on this project on and off for about 5 years (as you can see in my posting history on the forums). For a long time, I was unsure if I wanted to finish the game (for various reasons) and I was switching my perspective on whether this is simply a learning process or if I am trying to make an actual game. About two years ago, I concluded that both of these statements are true.
Some aspects of the story have dwelled in my mind for years, even before I created the project. In fact, my parents bought me RPG Maker MV back when I was still in elementary school, but I didn’t spend much time on it back then.
Now I am in a position where, in the following year, I will have quite a lot of free time (in comparison to my previous years), so I plan to give this project a high priority and I think it will be done, as I said before, around Q3/Q4 2026.
I have been thinking about announcing this project for a long time, and the reason why I decided to do it now is that I am able to work on it consistently for the upcoming months, and the fact that, while there‘s still a lot of work left to do, plenty of stuff is already done.
So far, every graphical element in the game was made by me. In order to take things further, including better visuals, improved sound design and overall quality, I’ve launched a Patreon. On Patreon, you can also become part of the game itself. Supporters have the option to vote in occasional polls, create a custom item or NPC that will be implemented directly into the world.
